sample_unit: fully onboarded clinicians (paired survey); editing metadata from 236,153 notes by 1295 clinicians

links.outcome: Self-reported documentation time per note and administrative stress before vs after AI scribe
links.effect: Documentation time 4.72 vs 6.69 min per note (-29%, P<.001); stress-free administrative work rating 3.14 vs 2.41 (P<.001); presence with patients 4.33 vs 3.73 (P<.001).
links.quote: Following the introduction of the AI medical scribe, the estimated time spent on documentation per note was lower than before (4.72 vs 6.69 minutes; -29%, P<.001).

screen.reason: Observational real-world evaluation of an ambient AI medical scribe assessing documentation time, editing behavior, and clinician experience, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
